title: Important Terms and Ideas for Describing Artificial Intelligence
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: There are several terms experts use to describe computer systems in the field of artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 在人工智能领域,专家用几个术语来描述计算机系统。

sentences.en: Recently, the French News Agency (AFP) defined some of the common terms and ideas used in that field.
sentences.zh: 最近,法国通讯社(AFP)界定了该领域使用的一些共同术语和想法。

sentences.en: Here is a version for English learners: Artificial intelligence The first term is “artificial intelligence.” When asked what artificial intelligence is, the AI-powered ChatGPT system says that the term means “the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think, learn and make decisions".
sentences.zh: 这是英国学生的版本:人工智能。 第一个术语是“人工智能 ” 。 当被问及人工智能是什么时, AI-power ChatGPT 系统说,这个词的意思是“在设计成思考、学习和决定的机器中模拟人类智能 ” 。

sentences.en: AI's main quality or characteristic is taking in large amounts of data and then processing it using methods from statistics .
sentences.zh: AI的主要质量或特征是大量的数据,然后使用统计方法处理。

sentences.en: AI involves using ideas from many fields including computing, mathematics, languages, psychology, and others.
sentences.zh: AI涉及使用许多领域的想法,包括计算、数学、语言、心理学等。

sentences.en: Currently, the technology is being used heavily for investigating health issues, translating human languages, and predicting problems in machine tools and self-driving cars.
sentences.zh: 目前,该技术正大量用于调查健康问题、翻译人文和预测机器工具和自行驾驶汽车方面的问题。

sentences.en: But AI is affecting many fields of business and industry.
sentences.zh: 但大赦国际正在影响许多商业和工业领域。

sentences.en: Algorithm A second important term is “algorithm.” An algorithm is important to all computer operations.
sentences.zh: 第二个重要术语是“algorithm ” 。 算法对所有计算机操作都很重要。

sentences.en: It is a series of steps or instructions followed by a computer program to get a result.
sentences.zh: 这是一系列步骤或指示,然后是计算机程序,以取得结果。

sentences.en: Algorithms can give rules for an AI's behavior, helping it to realize the objectives of computer program developers.
sentences.zh: 演算法可以为AI的行为提供规则, 帮助它实现计算机程序开发者的目标。

sentences.en: Unlike a simple computer program, AI algorithms permit a computer system to “learn” for itself.
sentences.zh: 与简单的计算机程序不同,人工智能算法允许计算机系统自己“学习”。

sentences.en: Machine learning A third important term is “machine learning.” Machine learning is one method that researchers have used in their efforts to produce artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: “机器学习”是第三个重要术语。 机器学习是研究人员在努力制造人工智能时使用的一种方法。

sentences.en: Machine learning lets computers learn from data without being directly programmed on what results to produce.
sentences.zh: 机器学习使计算机能够从数据中学习,而不必直接编程了解产生什么结果。

sentences.en: In recent years, the field of neural networks has given important results.
sentences.zh: 近年来,神经网络领域取得了重要成果。

sentences.en: In a neural network, connections between some nodes are strengthened and others weakened as the system learns and makes changes.
sentences.zh: 在神经网络中,一些节点之间的联系得到加强,其他节点随着系统学习和变革而削弱。

sentences.en: Learning can be "supervised." This means the system learns to put new data into specific groups based on a model.
sentences.zh: 学习可以被“监督 ” 。 这意味着这个系统学习将新数据 输入到基于模型的特定群体中。

sentences.en: For example, the system could learn to identify spam in an email or other messaging programs.
sentences.zh: 例如,该系统可以学会在电子邮件或其他信息程序中识别垃圾邮件。

sentences.en: "Unsupervised" learning permits the system to independently discover new areas or ways of doing things.
sentences.zh: “不受监督”的学习使系统能够独立地发现新的领域或做事方式。

sentences.en: These discoveries in the available data might not have been immediately clear.
sentences.zh: 现有数据中的这些发现可能并不立即清楚。

sentences.en: An example would be letting an online store identify buying trends in sales data.
sentences.zh: 一个例子就是让一家网上商店查明销售数据中的购买趋势。

sentences.en: "Reinforcement" learning adds a process of repeated trial-and-error.
sentences.zh: “加强”学习增加了反复审判的过程。

sentences.en: In this process, the system is rewarded based on its outcomes, causing it to learn and improve.
sentences.zh: 在这一过程中,该制度因其成果而得到奖励,从而得以学习和改进。

sentences.en: One example might be a self-driving vehicle whose objective is to reach its destination as quickly as possible but also safely.
sentences.zh: 一个例子可能是自驾车,其目的是尽快到达目的地,但也要安全。

sentences.en: That requirement would lead it to learn to stop at red lights although it requires additional time.
sentences.zh: 这一要求将促使它学会在红色灯光下停下来,尽管它需要更多的时间。

sentences.en: Deep learning Deep learning owes its name to its use of many layers of neural networks.
sentences.zh: 深层学习是因为它使用许多层次的神经网络。

sentences.en: Raw data is examined by each layer in turn at growing levels of abstraction .
sentences.zh: 原始数据由每一层在不断增长的抽象水平上逐级审查。

sentences.en: Geoffrey Hinton received the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics.
sentences.zh: Geoffrey Hinton获得2024年诺贝尔物理奖。

sentences.en: Hinton is credited with developing deep learning.
sentences.zh: 辛顿在深层次的学习中功不可没

sentences.en: Hinton received the prize along with 1980s neural-network developer John Hopfield.
sentences.zh: Hinton和1980年代神经网络开发商John Hopfield一起获得奖项。

sentences.en: Francis Bach, head of France's SIERRA statistical learning laboratory, said this about deep learning: "The more layers you have, the more complex behavior can become, and the more complex the behavior can be, the easier it is to learn a desired behavior efficiently ."
sentences.zh: 法国SIERRA统计学习实验室负责人Francis Bach说, “你越是深入学习, 行为就会越复杂, 行为也会越复杂,

sentences.en: The method might help lead to scientific discoveries.
sentences.zh: 这一方法可能有助于产生科学发现。

sentences.en: Language models We now turn to large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 语言模式 我们现在转向大型语言模式(LLMs)。

sentences.en: These might be the most popular example of generative AI.
sentences.zh: 这可能是最流行的人工智能例子。

sentences.en: Large language models power tools like OpenAI’s ChatGPT or Google’s Gemini.
sentences.zh: 例如OpenAI的ChatGPT或Google的双子座。

sentences.en: Such systems are able to write long papers, answer legal questions or even produce a cake recipe based on their statistical models.
sentences.zh: 这种系统能够撰写长篇论文,回答法律问题,甚至能够根据其统计模式制作蛋糕配方。

sentences.en: But the technology is still new. LLM’s can suffer from "hallucinations"- the creation of content that is false or incorrect.
sentences.zh: 但技术还是很新奇的。 LLM可能受到“催化”的影响 — — 产生虚假或不正确的内容。

sentences.en: Artificial general intelligence A final important term is artificial general intelligence (AGI) - one the big goals of the whole AI field.
sentences.zh: 最后一个重要的术语是人工一般情报(AGI),这是整个人工一般情报领域的一大目标。

sentences.en: AGI suggests the unrealized dream of a machine able to reproduce all human processes of human thinking.
sentences.zh: AGI提出一个未实现的梦想,即机器能够复制人类思想的所有过程。

sentences.en: People who push the idea include OpenAI chief Sam Altman and his competitors at Anthropic.
sentences.zh: 提出这个想法的人包括OpenAI头目Sam Altman和他的人类学的竞争对手。

sentences.en: They consider such a system to be within reach.
sentences.zh: 他们认为,这种制度是可以实现的。

sentences.en: The goal is to use large amounts of data and processing power to train LLMs that are increasingly powerful.
sentences.zh: 目标是利用大量数据和加工能力来培训越来越强大的LLMs。

sentences.en: But critics say that LLM technology has important limits, including its ability to reason.
sentences.zh: 但批评者说,LLM技术有重要的局限性,包括其理性能力。

sentences.en: Maxime Amblard, computing professor at France's University of Lorraine, told AFP last year, "LLMs do not work like human beings."
sentences.zh: 去年法国洛林大学计算学教授Maxime Amblard 告诉澳大利亚联邦统计局说,“LLMS不像人类一样工作。”

sentences.en: Amblard added that humans, as flesh-and-blood -intelligent beings, are "sense-making machines" with different abilities from today's computer systems.
sentences.zh: Amblard补充说,人类作为血肉之躯,是“智商制造机器”,其能力与当今的计算机系统不同。
